title: Timelock controller detection
detects: A successful call on an admin address means that admin is a timelock. Actions must be queued and cannot execute until the delay elapses.
knownFalseNegative: This is probed against the ADMIN address, not the token. A short delay is close to no delay at all, so the returned number matters as much as its presence.

coversExamples.observed: the address UNI's minter() returns, probed for a timelock delay

rationale: This pattern is what stops legitimate governance being scored like a rug. A live admin behind a real timelock is a normal, healthy design, and without this check every governance token false-positives.
